entries.definition: Money billed to customers. Sum of Invoice.Total (per invoice) or of InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity (per line); the two reconcile. Round money to 2 decimals.
entries.sql: ROUND(SUM(Invoice.Total), 2)  -- or ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) when grouping by track, album, artist, genre or media type

entries.definition: Number of tracks sold. Every invoice line has Quantity 1, so this is the number of InvoiceLine rows.
Ranked by units sold (number of tracks sold), not revenue. Use 'top-grossing' for revenue.
Ranked by revenue.
When the user asks for 'top' items with a clear metric but no number, show the top 5.
One row in Invoice. An invoice has one or more invoice lines (tracks).
Average of Invoice.Total over the invoices in scope, rounded to 2 decimals.
Average number of invoice lines (tracks) per invoice.
The data ends on 2025-12-22, the latest invoice date. Treat it as today for every relative period. This year = 2025, last year = 2024.
The most recent complete calendar quarter before the as-of date: Q3 2025 (2025-07-01 to 2025-09-30). 'This quarter' is Q4 2025 to date.
Calendar quarters: Q1 Jan-Mar, Q2 Apr-Jun, Q3 Jul-Sep, Q4 Oct-Dec.
A customer with at least one invoice in the 6 months up to the as-of date, i.e. on or after 2025-06-22.
entries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2025-06-22'

entries.definition: A customer who is not active: no invoice on or after 2025-06-22.
entries.sql: CustomerId NOT IN (SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2025-06-22')

entries.definition: Total revenue from one customer across all their invoices.
entries.sql: SELECT CustomerId, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId

entries.definition: A customer whose lifetime value is at least $45.00.
A customer counted in the period that holds their first invoice.
entries.sql: MIN(InvoiceDate) per CustomerId falls in the period

entries.definition: A customer with a non-empty Customer.Company. Others are individual (consumer) customers.
The employee in Customer.SupportRepId. A rep's sales are the revenue of the invoices of the customers they support.
entries.sql: JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = Customer.SupportRepId

entries.definition: North America: USA, Canada. South America: Brazil, Argentina, Chile. Asia: India. Oceania: Australia. Europe: every other country in the data (Austria, Belgium, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Spain, Sweden, United Kingdom). Use Invoice.BillingCountry for sales and Customer.Country for customers.
entries.sql: CASE WHEN Country IN ('USA','Canada') THEN 'North America' WHEN Country IN ('Brazil','Argentina','Chile') THEN 'South America' WHEN Country = 'India' THEN 'Asia' WHEN Country = 'Australia' THEN 'Oceania' ELSE 'Europe' END

entries.definition: A country. Sales by market use Invoice.BillingCountry; customers by market use Customer.Country.
Percentage change: (value in year Y - value in year Y-1) / value in year Y-1 * 100, rounded to 1 decimal.
Part divided by the total, times 100, rounded to 1 decimal.
A track whose MediaType.Name contains 'video' (Protected MPEG-4 video file). Every other media type is audio.
Track.UnitPrice 1.99 is premium; 0.99 is standard.
Track.Milliseconds. Minutes = Milliseconds / 60000.0. A long track runs over 10 minutes (Milliseconds > 600000).
All rows in Track, sold or not.
A track with no InvoiceLine row.
entries.sql: NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM InvoiceLine il WHERE il.TrackId = Track.TrackId)

entries.definition: Employee.ReportsTo holds the manager's EmployeeId. Direct reports of X are employees whose ReportsTo is X.
entries.sql: JOIN Employee m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo

entries.definition: Whole years from Employee.HireDate to the as-of date 2025-12-22.
Show people as one column: first name, a space, last name.
